post.caption:
Lightning is the doorknob shock, scaled up. Ice and hail collide inside a storm cloud and separate charge until the gap breaks down, and a 30,000 amp discharge follows. Thunder is not the strike itself. It is air heated so fast that it explodes outward as a shockwave.
